pointOfInterests.description: The Shire is a taste of what's to come. If this is too much for you, get out here.
pointOfInterests.name: The Shire

detail.description:
Data supplied by Jack Hession Sierra Club, 241 E. 5th Ave, Suite 205, Anchorage, AK 99501, and Andy Embick.

Gradients from Embick's book. Lat/longitude coordinates are approximate, from examining the Topozone maps. Embick's book gives detailed directions. The mentioned Hatcher Pass Road could not be found on the topo maps, so directions use Willow Creek Road.

See also the gnarly [Lower Canyon](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/57/).
